meta_description: TC Locksmiths 24/7 in Leeds — emergency locksmith services, lock repairs, and key replacements. Available round the clock. Call now for fast help.
hero_subhead: Stuck outside your home or business? Our mobile locksmiths arrive within 30 minutes, day or night, across all of Leeds.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock upgrades and key cutting, we handle every lock problem fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, car, or office? We arrive within 30 minutes and get you back inside without damage. No call-out charge.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, jammed mechanisms, and worn cylinders fixed or replaced on the spot. All work guaranteed.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Spare keys cut while you wait — standard and security keys alike. We use precision equipment for a perfect fit every time.

services.title: Lock Upgrades & Security
services.desc: Upgrade to high-security locks and anti-snap cylinders. Ideal for rental properties and elderly relatives' homes.

services.title: UPVC & Modern Door Locks
services.desc: Specialist repairs and replacements for modern composite and UPVC doors. We carry parts for common mechanisms.

services.title: Commercial Locksmith Services
services.desc: Key management systems, emergency access for businesses, and master key rekeying. Discreet, rapid service.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got locked out myself and waited three hours. Never again.
about_para_1: TC Locksmiths 24/7 was founded on a simple frustration: poor response times when people needed help most. Over the last eight years, we've built a reputation for arriving fast, fixing it right, and charging fairly. Every locksmith on our team carries full stock and diagnostic tools — no second visits, no surprises.
about_para_2: We serve households and businesses across Leeds every single day. Repeat customers trust us because we're honest about what's needed, we never upcharge for out-of-hours work, and we back our repairs with a 12-month guarantee. Whether it's 3 a.m. on a Sunday or a Tuesday afternoon, you get the same quality and speed.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Residents Say About Us

reviews.text: Got locked out of the flat at midnight on a Friday. Called TC and someone arrived in less than 20 minutes. Professional, quick, and didn't try to oversell me anything. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: My elderly mum had a dodgy lock on her front door. Rather than replace the whole thing, they just fixed the cylinder. Saved her a fortune and the job was done same day. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: Business premises got broken into and the door frame was damaged. TC came out, reinforced the lock with a high-security cylinder, and gave sensible advice on what to do next. Really reliable outfit.
reviews.author: Rajesh P.
